ledger_review.performed_by: read-only proxy review with delegated ledger/state cross-check

methods: Read-only audit; no real API requests, DUT execution, credential access, production changes, or new test suite runs.
Check exact unique 216 row keys/order against registration and check all 85 frozen input bytes, sizes, SHA256 and current registered input bytes.

Recompute with the registered-hash-matching strict summary helper in memory and compare every generated summary field; helper verifies all saved execution-side plan/contract/RTL/TB/reference-sampling/output bindings.

Independently parse every saved structured RESULT/FAILURE line from all 480 stdout files; reconcile checks/failures, derive detection and first-detection cumulative cycles, compare all rows and aggregate denominators.

Check all 108 API trajectories and each recorded request/usage; delegated read-only helper reconstructs all 145 canonical HTTP bodies and wire/prompt digests from frozen sources and saved states, matches ledger sequence/reservations/settlements.
Check public copies/rows/strategies, every public artifact SHA/size, the 86-member ZIP (manifest plus 85 files), safe unique paths, CRC, exact file set and bytes against the original snapshots.
Read report and budget wording as scope-limited observational development-set claims; bind final report and public receipt bytes.
known_limitations: Four entirely unexecuted tasks remain in all registered denominators; nine policy_error end states include five tasks with a prior executed round. Strict whole-comparison eligibility remains false.

Row126 decision2 is json_invalid with response_chars=424 and untrusted_response_status=not_saved. The malformed original response cannot be inspected; only the validation/usage trace and prior one-round 40-cycle execution remain reviewable.

The dataset is eight known development defects repeated three times, not 24 independent defects or an unseen held-out sample. Counts do not establish statistical superiority, generalization or user benefit.
Both multi-round API groups add only one first detection in round2; most detections occur in round1. Results do not establish feedback causality.
No-feedback hides pure input/port precheck correction as well as DUT observations and coverage, and result-dependent early stopping remains. Later-request presence can retain outcome information.
Shared cumulative cycle caps do not make actual cycles or requests equal: baseline groups use 828 cycles each; single/feedback/no_feedback use 651/681/716 respectively.

Public compact directory omits complete raw execution-side logs. Registered byte ZIP is authoritative for real input bytes; review does not certify clean-checkout, cross-machine, human/H01/H02, provider billing, oracle physical truth, or external CI.

One historical unknown request remains a historical reservation. Historical 857957 reported tokens are not deducted from this new 1M batch; 1257040 is reported-token historical plus current total, not an exact service bill.
